attributes.residual: REGISTER_ONLY, now precisely bounded: real 264 = 125 paired diff words plus the reorder stray. 111/125 fit sigma exactly; 14 deviate, in three named groups. GROUP A (2 words, fn+0x1xx): target `addi r31,r3,0` / `add r26,r31,r0` where ours colours r20 and sigma predicts r19. GROUP B (7 words): the three callee-saved address-PRE pointers into gDefaultPlayerPosition (+0/+4/+8) plus the hoisted &gFloorCollisionResult+0x44 pointer - target r20/r22/r23 and r25, ours r21/r23/r25 and r20, i.e. the four pointer webs are colour-rotated among themselves relative to sigma. GROUP C (5 words): FPR - target's `lfd f29` threshold constant and its `fcmpo f0,f29` land in ours' f28 (sigma predicts f30), and target's `frsp f2,f31` x2 plus `fmul f31,f2,f30` land in ours' f30 (sigma predicts f29). NOT WebFrank register-stage eligible: 14 words deviate from the only consistent renaming, so the residual is not a clean renaming bisimulation. Closing GROUPS A-C is the named next step, and Group B (four mutually-rotated pointer webs) is the largest and most tractable. SEPARATE, INDEPENDENT residual - the frame: a complete stack-slot census of both builds (every (r1) reference, both sides) shows EVERY slot identical - 48, 100/104/108, 128/132/136, 140..160, stmw at 172, LR at 260 - EXCEPT the two fabs-idiom compiler temps, which the target places at 32/36 and ours at 16/20 (constant 16-byte delta, 8 diff words). These temps are the only occupants of the low local area besides slot 48, so the delta is the size of the region below the temp pool, not a named local. Splitting the u8 unused_8[24] pad into 16+8 to seed a pad below the pool measured BYTE-IDENTICAL, and the outgoing-parameter-area theory was falsified directly (ErrorPrintf is already declared variadic and every call site is identical in both builds).
